name: The number is the hero
rule: On money and metric screens, the key figure is the largest, highest-contrast element, with labels and trends quieter.

leaders.note: Ranks data by importance. The most important figures get the highest contrast, the largest area and the top position, with few metrics and generous white space.
Metric blocks pair a small secondary-colour caption with a bold headline value. A sparkline beside it adds direction without competing with the number.
